Empezás con Surge (busca más piezas), se: You start with Surge (it searches for more pieces), follow with Crackle as an interruption on the opponent's turn, and finish with Whisker. Breakaway sets a Blitzclique Continuous Trap or returns a Thunder to destroy a card; Alternator searches for a different Thunder.
Es un arquetipo nuevo y las listas todav: It's a new archetype and the decklists are still changing. Effects that stop Summons from the hand hurt it, and so do Hand traps on the key pieces.
Núcleo de Rituales de Caos (set de 2026): Chaos Ritual core (2026 set): "Light and Darkness Ritual" (Ritual of Light and Darkness in the OCG) Ritual Summons Black Luster Soldier or Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos. The card lets you tribute monsters from your hand or field and also banish monsters from your Graveyard (GY) to reach the required Level.
Black Luster Soldier (Nivel 8, 3000 ATK): Black Luster Soldier (Level 8, 3000 ATK) isn't destroyed by battle and, when Summoned, banishes a card from the opponent. Black Chaos is Summoned from the hand by shuffling a Ritual Spellcaster or Warrior and banishes two of the opponent's cards. Skull Archfiend of Chaos is Summoned from the hand or Graveyard (GY) by putting three cards from the GY or banished cards on the bottom of the Deck.
Si te niegan el Ritual o no tenés los ma: If your Ritual gets negated or you don't have the materials, your hand is stuck with big monsters and no way out. The deck relies on a few key cards, so Hand traps hurt.
Nuevas cartas de Magician of Black Chaos: New Magician of Black Chaos and Black Luster Soldier cards (YGOPRODeck)
Dark Magician y sus apoyos por un lado y: Dark Magician and its support on one side and the Chaos Rituals on the other: the deck uses the Magicians as a search and protection engine, and "Light and Darkness Ritual" as the end of the play. It's one of the most played decks in the 2026 meta.
Se busca el Ritual y las piezas de Caos: You search for the Ritual and the Chaos pieces with the Dark Magician monsters, Summon Black Luster Soldier or Black Chaos, and protect them with the archetype's Spells and Traps.
Combina dos mazos, así que la mano puede: It combines two decks, so your hand can end up with pieces from both sides without completing either one. Hand traps cut the search steps.
Mazo de Fusión que usa a Albaz (Fallen o: Fusion deck that uses Albaz (Fallen of Albaz) as its engine: "Branded Fusion" and other cards let you Fusion Summon with materials from the Deck, and the Albaz monsters work as materials that also search for more cards. It adapts well to different boss monsters.
Con Branded Fusion o Branded in High Spi: With Branded Fusion or Branded in High Spirits you quickly Fusion Summon a boss monster (Albion, Granguignol, Mirrorjade) and leave the board with negations. The "Bystial" monsters and the Albaz engine mix with almost any Fusion deck.
Es de los mazos más complicados: hay que: It's one of the most complicated decks: you have to memorize the order of the plays. Hand traps that stop Albaz or the Branded search leave it with no board.
Mazo de Fusión de Spellcasters con Mediu: Spellcaster Fusion deck with Medius the Pure and the Artmage: you build a board with different monster Types, and when there are three or more different Types the Artmage negate and destroy whatever the opponent activates. Medius is also played as a standalone piece in other decks.
Se invoca a Medius, se hace una Fusión A: Summon Medius, make an Artmage Fusion with Artmage Pact, and search for the support to get 3 monster Types on the field.
Necesita variedad de monstruos en el cam: It needs a variety of monsters on the field to activate its negations, so you stop it by attacking its materials before they build the board.
Mazo de Hechizos: la mayoría se juega un: Spell deck: most of the cards are played one after another, and each Spell used puts resources on the field. You Summon Sky Striker Ace - Raye (Link) and go from there to the bigger Aces. It wins through consistency and the number of Spells it activates per turn.
Con Engage! se invoca a Raye, se activan: With Engage! you Summon Raye, activate Spells that charge up effects, and get to an Ace with a negation or destruction effect.
Muy sensible a lo que corte sus Hechizos: Very vulnerable to anything that shuts down its Spells (Anti-Spell Fragrance, Imperial Order) and to effects that activate in the chain.
Mazo de Fusión de Aleister the Invoker:: Aleister the Invoker Fusion deck: it searches for "Invocation" and Fusion Summons using materials from the hand and the Graveyard (GY) with the Invoked monsters. It's played on its own and, above all, as an engine in other Fusion decks.
Aleister invoca a Magellanica; «Invocati: Aleister Summons Magellanica; "Invocation" Fusion Summons with materials from the Deck or Graveyard (GY), getting to a monster like Mudragon of the Swamp or Aeon.
Poco desarrollo sin Aleister; los efecto: It develops very little without Aleister; effects that stop it in the hand leave it with no plays.
Mazo de Ritual de Reptiles. Sus Rituales: Reptile Ritual deck. Its Rituals destroy all of the opponent's monsters when Summoned, and the Mitsurugi quick effects make the opponent discard or negate. It's played on its own and mixed with Yummy, Azamina and Fiendsmith.
Se arma el Ritual de Mitsurugi con la ay: You set up the Mitsurugi Ritual with the help of Mitsurugi Mirror and get to Ame no Murakumo, which wipes out the opponent's monsters.
Sin su Ritual la mano queda débil; pierd: Without its Ritual the hand is weak; it loses to anything that negates the Ritual Spell.
Mazo de Fusión Péndulo de Bestias Guerre: Lunalight Beast-Warrior Pendulum Fusion deck: the dancers are Summoned and Fusion Summoned in a chain using the Pendulum Scales.
Se colocan las escalas, se invocan Lunal: Set the Scales, Summon Lunalight monsters from the hand, and Fusion Summon into Lunalight Leo Dancer or Kaleido Chick.
Es largo y pide práctica; los Hand traps: It's a long combo and takes practice; Hand traps cut the play. Pendulum monsters can't be used in Genesys.
Mazo de Tuners y Sincros con los Synchro: Tuner and Synchro deck with the Synchron monsters: you search for a Tuner with Junk Synchron and build a chain of Synchros. Great for learning how Tuners work.
Junk Synchron revive un monstruo de Nive: Junk Synchron revives a Level 2 or lower monster from the Graveyard (GY), and you make a Synchro with the Tuner.
Los Sincros se frenan con cartas que nie: Synchros are stopped by cards that negate Summons.
Mazo de monstruos Oscuros que se invocan: Deck of DARK monsters that are Summoned from the Graveyard (GY) with Traps and used for Rank 3 Xyz.
Se manda un Phantom Knight al Cementerio: Send a Phantom Knight to the Graveyard (GY), a Trap Summons it, and you make an Xyz.
El cementerio es su recurso: los efectos: The Graveyard (GY) is its resource: effects that banish it stop the deck.
Mazo Sincro de Hadas de Luz basado en el: Chess-themed LIGHT Fairy Synchro deck: its Synchros work best as Continuous Spells.
Arquetipo exclusivo del TCG de piezas de: TCG-exclusive archetype of chess pieces. Its monsters are LIGHT Synchros that, besides being monsters, are placed as Continuous Spells in the Spell & Trap Zone and banish the opponent's cards depending on how each piece captures.
Destrier busca un Hechizo Angelechy y ha: Destrier searches for an Angelechy Spell and deals damage, Shatranga (King) limits the opponent to 5 monster effects per turn, and Bastion protects the others and banishes cards in its column. The goal is to leave several Synchros as Continuous Spells plus a supporting Field Spell.
Las fuentes difieren: una lo considera d: Sources disagree: one considers it too good, and another says the first decklists were incomplete, and a second wave of support came out. Cards that destroy Continuous Spells or negate Synchros stop it.
Mazo de Ciberso Oscuro que se revive des: DARK Cyberse deck that revives after being banished and builds Links with its own Traps.
Los monstruos Maliss se invocan de nuevo: Maliss monsters Summon themselves again after being banished, by paying Life Points, and you're then limited to Summoning only Cyberse. Maliss Traps can be activated the turn they're Set if you banish a Maliss you control, and that gives a lot of Link material.

Dormouse banishes another Maliss from the Deck so it Summons itself (for example White Rabbit), and White Rabbit sets a Maliss Trap. It's almost always best to set the Trap before starting the combo: it works as an interruption.
«Maliss <Q> White Binder» está en la lis: "Maliss <Q> White Binder" is on the current Forbidden list and competitive decklists were hit by the banlist. The deck can be mixed with Fiendsmith and Bystial, but it's tied to Link Summoning.
Mazo Sincro de Nivel 2 con el Link Snatc: Level 2 Synchro deck with the Link monster Snatchy, which builds Synchros even on the opponent's turn.
Los Sincros de Nivel 2 de Yummy se invoc: Yummy's Level 2 Synchros are Summoned using Link-1 monsters as Level 1 Tuners. Snatchy can start a Synchro Summon during the opponent's turn, and the Synchros return to the Extra Deck when Yummy monsters are Summoned from the Graveyard (GY).
Cupsy es el mejor iniciador porque equiv: Cupsy is the best starter because it counts as three bodies and holds up better against Hand traps. Several Yummy-named effects only work if you Summon them with a Synchro.
Si te cortan el Link-1 inicial, se traba: If your starting Link-1 gets stopped, the deck stalls. It's also often mixed with Mitsurugi or Fiendsmith to gain interruptions.
Mazo de Ritual con White Forest y los Az: Ritual deck with White Forest and the Azamina: it builds strong boards and mixes with Mitsurugi and Chaos Ritual.
Se juega siguiendo la historia de las ca: It's played following the story of the cards: you start with Elzette and Astellar (or Silvy) to get to Rciela, and the goal is to hold Elzette, Azamina and Diabellze in hand, which connect to the rest.
Las listas competitivas llevan unos 11 W: Competitive decklists run about 11 White Forest and 17 Spells and Traps, and two copies of Elzette because it sometimes gets banished and there's no way to bring it back.
«Droll & Lock Bird» lo frena fuerte. Sai: "Droll & Lock Bird" shuts it down hard. Saint Azamina breaks Snake-Eye boards.
Mazo de Spellcasters Magistus que se mez: Magistus Spellcaster deck that mixes with Fairy Tail and Endymion to set up an OTK or a board that's very hard to break.
Los Magistus buscan y extienden la jugad: The Magistus search and extend the play; Zoroa is the most valuable and Crowley a good extender. The mix with Fairy Tail (Magistus Fairy Tail) aims for an OTK and, if it falls short, passes with a board that's hard to break.
Se recomienda mirar el tablero y la mano: It's recommended to check the opponent's board and hand before committing to the play.
Fydraulis Harmonia sobre Luna o Zoroa co: Fydraulis Harmonia on Luna or Zoroa cuts your turn short if you don't have extenders, and Droll & Lock Bird is also a big problem.
